response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.event_type, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Snapshots with no event type are those where corpeventprx IS NULL; these are excluded from the groups. Empty-string values are treated as real event types.
Each event type's average absolute difference is AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) over that group's rows, and rows where either percentage is NULL are skipped by AVG.
The overall average is the plain (unweighted) mean of the per-event-type average differences, skipping any group whose average is NULL. If that mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
Event-type groups whose own average difference is NULL (all their differences missing) are still listed, with NULL values for the difference columns.
No rounding is applied; AVG on the integer anlycount returns a numeric result at full precision.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat empty or whitespace-only corpeventprx values as 'no event type', in addition to NULL, so they are excluded from the groups.
alternatives.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(corpeventprx), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.event_type, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
